limitations: Designed after seeing outcome values; feature-stability results exploratory and potentially overfit
Leave-one-out shares almost all samples and is not independent validation
Raw-versus-log direction is often invariant to monotonic transforms but mean effects need not be; two transforms are not broad preprocessing validation
Rotations are not a null with proven exchangeability under batch/condition confounding
Rows are correlated and repeated metabolite names remain; no independently held-out cohort or fair strongest comparator
Metabolite peak ratios do not measure antigen dose or vaccine efficacy
